svg.text: AI travel and aviation agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, delivered on WhatsApp via AWS End User Messaging Social
parse event, mark read, call agent,
forwards JWT, scopes memory per user
Strands agent · Claude on Amazon Bedrock
inbound JWT auth (Cognito) · container from Amazon ECR
local tools: knowledge search, calculator, date calculator
16 tools exposed to the agent · inbound OAuth (Cognito)
Cedar rules, default deny, Enforce mode
aviation library: Amazon S3 documents + Web Crawler
calendar file, country info, exchange rates, ground transport,
Google Places API (New) · API key from AgentCore Identity
Tavily search · API key from AgentCore Identity
visas, airline policies, advisories, bus operators
1 Traveller messages the Airxpact WhatsApp number
2 End User Messaging Social publishes the message event to SNS
3 SNS invokes the whatsapp_eum Lambda (dedupe, session, read receipt)
4 Lambda gets a Cognito token and invokes AgentCore Runtime
5 Agent loads short- and long-term memory (and the knowledge base)
6 Agent gets an OAuth token from Identity and calls Gateway tools over MCP
7 Policy (Cedar) allows or denies each tool call
8 Tools fetch live data, save booking requests, notify the team
9 Answer returns to the Lambda, which replies with SendWhatsAppMessage
Orange = qualifying AWS communication service path · Blue = web and partner path
